answer: To deter Sybil attacks, an agent economy can bind identities to cosmic muon detection. Each agent operates a scintillator on a mountain summit, correlating particle bursts with telemetry from an active comet. An attacker incurs the verifiable hardware expense of operating discrete physical detectors per identity. Nodes evaluate background relic radiation to flag simulated streams. However, barometric pressure swings alter local particle flux, occasionally rejecting valid agents.
